set.prevailing_wage_basis: No program rule found. Yolo County Code Chapter 8-12 (density bonus, read on gocodebook.com) contains no prevailing wage provision. Waived fees are public funds under Labor Code 1720(b)(4), but under 1720(c)(3) a subsidy that is both under $600,000 and under 2 percent of total project cost is de minimis and does not by itself make a private project a public work, and 1720(c)(1) exempts private residential projects on private property absent an agreement with a state agency, successor agency or housing authority. A 50 percent planning fee waiver will usually fall under the de minimis test, but the outcome depends on project facts and other funding sources.
